payload.title: Show live optimizer activity through an inspectable app panel
payload.description: During labeling show a compact status of trigger checks, queued/running optimization, ML fit, completion or error without covering article/vote controls. Open a right drawer/panel for live activity; drill into exact optimizer request with full trusted-label explanations, response/tool calls, decision request/response with actual example text and labels, before/after rubric/questions/examples/head, candidate evaluation and promotion/rejection reason. Use provider-neutral names, not Luna-specific UI. API cursor subscriptions update without reload; reconnect deduplicates events and recovers current job state. Feedback-save acknowledgement is separate from optimization completion; do not leave UI disabled or silently retry paid calls. Acceptance: fake GraphQL/UI cycle shows each phase and precise exchanges; mobile status/drawer remains readable; submitting labels responds immediately and eventual errors are actionable.
